要打开的条目已不存在，可能已被删除。目录仍可浏览；请从左侧目录重新选择。: This entry is no longer available. Choose another from the list.
这本书还没有关联世界书。: No story bible linked to this book.
回写作工作台右栏「关联世界书」完成关联后，这里会打开它的条目。: Use Link story bible in the writing sidebar to see its entries here.
描述世界观的基本设定、背景故事、核心概念等。这是 AI 生成内容时必须遵循的基础: World, background and core ideas the AI should follow.
定义叙事风格、语言风格、情感基调等。例如：采用第三人称叙事，语言简洁有力，注重心: Voice, language and tone. E.g. third person, concise prose, close attention to inner thoughts.
提供示例供 AI 参考，帮助理解预期的输出风格和格式。可以是优秀的叙事片段示例。: Add passages that illustrate the style and format you want.
定义 AI 不应该生成的内容类型、风格或元素。例如：避免过于现代的口语、不出现某: Content, styles or elements to avoid. E.g. modern slang or specific topics.
导入前会先显示摘要预览，确认后再创建新世界书。: Preview the file before confirming. Import creates a new story bible.
当前没有分组，可先创建。: No groups yet. Create one below.
模型只提出候选，确认后才会写入条目。: AI suggests changes. Entries change only when you apply them.
可选：补充审查重点，例如“重点检查角色关系和历史年代是否冲突”。: Optional: focus on character relationships, dates or other details.
例如：保留已有时间线，补充这个势力与北境盐路的利益关系，不要创造新年代。: E.g. keep the timeline and clarify this faction’s interests in the salt route.
例如：增加一个控制北境盐路的商会，和霜港存在利益冲突，但不要改变已有历史。: E.g. add a salt-trading guild in conflict with the port, without changing established history.
世界书已在生成后发生变化，这批建议已过期。请重新运行审查，避免覆盖新的设定。: The story bible has changed. These suggestions are outdated. Run a new review to protect your latest changes.
只锚定当前说话角色；生成时最多使用前 3 条，空白与重复样例会在保存时清理。: Applies only to this speaker. AI uses up to the first three examples. Empty and duplicate examples are removed on save.
句长、措辞、回避或强调习惯: Sentence length, phrasing, avoidance or emphasis
拉丁文本要求词边界匹配（中文默认短语匹配）: Match word boundaries in Latin text. Chinese uses phrase matching.
修改后点击「保存条目」生效: Click Save entry to apply changes.
请选择一个条目进行编辑，或点击“新增条目”。: Select an entry to edit, or choose New entry.
尚无可编辑世界书，点击上方“新建世界书”开始。: Choose New story bible to get started.
JSON 结构无效：需要对象根节点: Invalid JSON: the root must be an object.
世界书处理失败。: Could not process the story bible.
请先输入自然语言要求或选择条目。: Enter instructions or select entries first.
AI 返回无法解析为世界书处理结果。: Could not read the AI’s proposed changes.
AI 返回的世界书处理结果未通过本地校验。: The AI’s proposed changes did not pass validation.
上游模型连续返回空内容，已自动重试 3 次；请检查当前模型是否只输出思考过程，或: The model returned no content after three retries. Check whether it only returned reasoning, or try another text model.
已生成候选，请逐项审阅。: Suggestions ready. Review each before applying.
世界书已经发生变化，这批建议已过期，请重新审查。: The story bible has changed. Run a new review before applying suggestions.
这条建议涉及本批次中已经修改过的条目，请重新审查后再采纳，避免旧建议覆盖刚保存的: This suggestion affects entries already changed in this batch. Run a new review to avoid overwriting those changes.
建议内容为空，请先编辑或重新生成。: The suggestion is empty. Edit it or generate again.
建议对应的条目已经不存在。: The suggested entry no longer exists.
目标分组「{target}」已存在，重命名将合并条目，是否继续？: Group “{target}” exists. Renaming will combine the groups’ entries. Continue?
确认将「{source}」的条目迁移到「{target}」，并删除源分组？: Move entries from “{source}” to “{target}” and delete the source group?
确认将「{source}」的条目迁移到「{target}」并保留源分组？: Move entries from “{source}” to “{target}” and keep the source group?
已迁移 {count} 条条目到「{target}」，并删除了源分组。: Moved {count} entries to “{target}” and deleted the source group.
确认删除分组「{source}」？其中 {count} 条条目的分组将被清空。: Delete group “{source}”? Its {count} entries will become ungrouped, not deleted.
